title: 英矽智能CEO：公司首次盈利，本人增持权益资产彰显信心
speaker: Alex Zhavoronkov

segments.en: We have a sustainable business model. You have seen that we have turned profit for the first time in our history. So both AI component and the drug component is growing off the business.
segments.zh: 我们拥有可持续的商业模式。大家看到，我们历史上首次实现盈利。AI业务和药物业务都在增长。

segments.en: So even if this drug, you know, may not, it's a drug, drug, drug discovery, it's a casino. But in this particular casino, we have probably higher chances of success than most other companies,
segments.zh: 即使这款药物可能不成功——药物研发就像赌博——但在这场赌博中，我们可能比其他大多数公司有更高的成功几率，

segments.en: because we've reached phase three ourselves on such a timeframe on such a budget. And we have many, many more drugs to fall onto if something doesn't work. But it's very promising.
segments.zh: 因为我们在这样的时间和预算内自行推进到了三期。而且我们还有很多其他药物作为后备。这非常有希望。

segments.en: And I think that currently there is no drug that can give you even one year of life, regardless of whether you're rich or poor. So in a success here, even with a few years,
segments.zh: 我认为目前还没有任何药物能延长哪怕一年的寿命，无论贫富。因此，如果成功，即使延长几年，

segments.en: additional to your lifespan and health span would be an enormous achievement first time in the world. So that's what I live for. I actually don't care about pretty much anything else. So I can definitely guarantee you that I will continue.
segments.zh: 延长寿命和健康寿命也将是举世瞩目的巨大成就。这就是我为之奋斗的目标。我几乎不在乎其他任何事情。我可以向你保证，我会继续努力。

segments.en: You probably have seen that we made an announcement that I am buying stock right now. Actually, as a CEO, I have to go through many roadblocks and apply to your board and go through compliance to be able to do that.
segments.zh: 你可能已经看到我们宣布我正在增持股票。实际上，作为CEO，我必须经过许多程序，向董事会申请并通过合规审查才能这样做。

segments.en: So I started accumulating as well, because I think that now, with this particular direction now, we look very promising.
segments.zh: 所以我开始增持，因为我认为现在，沿着这个方向，我们看起来非常有希望。

segments.en: Can you clarify about the stock buying? How much of the stock have you bought? We have made an announcement in Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 您能澄清一下股票增持的情况吗？您买了多少？我们在香港发布了公告。

segments.en: You have to be extremely compliant. And we've made an announcement that I will accumulate the stock. So once I finish buying, we will announce how much. But currently it's up to 16 million Hong Kong.
segments.zh: 我们必须非常合规。我们已经宣布我将增持股票。一旦完成购买，我们会公布具体金额。目前已经增持了1600万港元。

segments.en: For me, considering that I'm on a salary and I've previously participated in our previous rounds, such as Rowan D, like for me, it's a considerable number. So I'm a big believer.
segments.zh: 对我而言，考虑到我拿薪水，并且之前参与了公司的融资轮次，这对我来说是一个相当大的数字。所以我是坚定的看好者。
